name: Mary Mulcahy
story: Mary Mulcahy selected ballot cards and processed military-service records during 1917–18 within the geographically organised recruiting system.

Mary Mulcahy selected ballot cards and processed military-service records in 1917–18, within a system organised through mapped recruiting districts. Her work helped maintain the records linking people and military-service decisions with place.
